source: First failing checkpoint detected on a captured witness plus 1024 deterministic samples: 97204 -> 97113 gates.
strategy: Probabilistic variable replacement; replaces control 31 with 12 in both outer Toffoli gates.
output_difference: Only wire 58 differs, by x10 AND x7 AND x29 AND x16 AND x12 AND NOT x31.
verification: Exhaustive enumeration of all 2048 assignments to the 11 effective wires. Other wires are untouched.
fix: Sampling may reject candidates, but acceptance requires exact polynomial equivalence. Resource exhaustion declines a candidate.
whole_checkpoint_isolation: Applying only the two identified gate substitutions to the preceding checkpoint reproduces the failing checkpoint on 4096 additional deterministic inputs; unrelated reorderings/rewrites account for the remaining gate count change.

post_fix_trial.termination: Stopped deliberately at the test limit; not a claim of complete optimization.
